candidate_concepts.label: GitHub Copilot AI Coding Assistant
candidate_concepts.description: GitHub Copilot is an AI-powered tool that assists developers in writing, testing, and fixing code. It provides code completions, chat, and agent modes to automate tasks across the software development lifecycle.
coverage_criteria: The student can describe the purpose of GitHub Copilot and list at least two ways it assists in development (e.g., code generation, code review, debugging).

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source body prominently features GitHub Copilot, describing it as an AI partner that works at each step of the SDLC, with demonstrations of code refactoring and agent mode.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This candidate focuses on the core concept of Copilot as an AI assistant, narrow enough to be checked with a few questions about its functionalities.

source_anchors.locator: Your AI partner everywhere. Copilot is ready to work with you at each step of the software development lifecycle.

candidate_concepts.label: GitHub Actions CI/CD Automation
candidate_concepts.description: GitHub Actions is a CI/CD tool that automates software workflows, including building, testing, and deploying code, directly from GitHub repositories.
coverage_criteria: The student can explain what CI/CD is and how GitHub Actions supports automation of software delivery.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source highlights 'Automate your path to production' with GitHub Actions, showcasing a workflow dashboard and emphasizing secure, reliable CI/CD.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This candidate captures a single platform feature, suitable for a brief check on understanding of automation in DevOps.

candidate_concepts.label: GitHub Codespaces Cloud Development Environment
candidate_concepts.description: GitHub Codespaces provides a fully configured, cloud-based development environment that can be launched instantly, allowing developers to code from anywhere.
coverage_criteria: The student can describe what a cloud development environment is and how Codespaces enables remote development without local setup.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source presents Codespaces with the heading 'Code instantly from anywhere' and a picker screenshot comparing local and Codespaces.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: The concept is distinct from other GitHub features and can be verified by asking the student to identify its purpose.

candidate_concepts.label: GitHub Advanced Security with Copilot Autofix
candidate_concepts.description: GitHub Advanced Security includes Copilot Autofix, which automatically identifies and fixes vulnerabilities in code, reducing security debt and mean time to recovery.
coverage_criteria: The student can explain how Copilot Autofix helps remediate security vulnerabilities, potentially with an example like XSS prevention.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source provides a detailed example of Copilot Autofix fixing an XSS vulnerability, along with a security campaign dashboard and statistics.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This candidate is specific enough to test understanding of automated security fixes without delving into broader security concepts.

source_anchors.locator: Apply fixes in seconds. Spend less time debugging and more time building features with Copilot Autofix.
Copilot Autofix identifies vulnerable code and provides an explanation, together with a secure code suggestion to remediate the vulnerability.

candidate_concepts.label: GitHub Dependabot for Dependency Management
candidate_concepts.description: Dependabot automatically updates vulnerable dependencies in a project, providing supported fixes and managing breaking changes to maintain software supply chain security.
coverage_criteria: The student can describe what Dependabot does and why dependency management is important for security.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source mentions 'Dependencies you can depend on. Update vulnerable dependencies with supported fixes for breaking changes' and shows a dependency list.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This is a single tool within GitHub's security features, making it appropriate for a focused check.

source_anchors.locator: Dependencies you can depend on. Update vulnerable dependencies with supported fixes for breaking changes.

candidate_concepts.label: GitHub Projects for Issue Tracking and Planning
candidate_concepts.description: GitHub Projects provides a project management tool integrated with repositories, allowing teams to organize tasks, track progress, and plan roadmaps using boards and tables.
coverage_criteria: The student can explain how GitHub Projects helps manage software projects, mentioning features like custom views, status tracking, and sub-issue progress.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source features 'Plan with clarity. Organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks.' with a project board example and an issue with sub-issues.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This candidate covers project management features, which are distinct from coding tools, and can be assessed by asking about task organization.

source_anchors.locator: Plan with clarity. Organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks.

candidate_concepts.label: GitHub Code Review with Copilot Assistance
candidate_concepts.description: GitHub's code review feature allows team members to review code changes together, with optional initial reviews by Copilot to increase speed and quality.
coverage_criteria: The student can describe the code review process on GitHub and how Copilot can be used to automate initial reviews.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source states 'Review code changes together Assign initial reviews to Copilot for greater speed and quality' and shows a pull request status with approvals.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This candidate focuses on the code review process as enhanced by AI, specific enough to check understanding of modern development practices.

source_local_connector_candidates.reason: The source explicitly links GitHub Copilot to code review by stating 'Assign initial reviews to Copilot for greater speed and quality'.
The source presents Copilot Autofix as a feature of GitHub Copilot, showing how it automatically fixes vulnerabilities.

source_anchors.locator: Apply fixes in seconds. Spend less time debugging and more time building features with Copilot Autofix.
